name: aria_diagnostics_health
description: Read live host memory, load, uptime, Unraid and source versions, worker observation and job counts.

name: aria_diagnostics_storage
description: Read filesystem use and mount inventory without scanning file contents.

name: aria_diagnostics_shares
description: List Unraid share settings, including SMB export and access lists, excluding credentials.

name: aria_diagnostics_permissions
description: Inspect POSIX ownership and permissions for one existing path under /mnt; does not recurse or modify files.

name: aria_diagnostics_container
description: Diagnose one container using Docker state, OOM and restart evidence, mount existence and redacted recent logs.

name: aria_diagnostics_resources
description: Sample container CPU, RAM, network, block I/O and PIDs. Retains up to 64 bounded snapshots locally.

name: aria_diagnostics_resource_history
description: Read up to 20 retained resource snapshots collected on demand or by a configured monitoring schedule.

name: aria_diagnostics_network
description: Run a bounded host DNS, TCP, HTTP or TLS certificate check. DNS needs host; TCP needs host and port; TLS needs host and optional port (443); HTTP needs url. No redirects, credentials or response bodies are returned.

name: aria_diagnostics_devices
description: List GPU utilization, PCI and USB inventory using installed host tools. Missing dependencies are reported.

name: aria_diagnostics_disks
description: List block devices, filesystems, models and mountpoints using lsblk.

name: aria_diagnostics_vm_list
description: List all native libvirt VMs and their current state.

name: aria_diagnostics_vm_inspect
description: Read one VM configuration, disks, interfaces and passed-through devices, excluding secrets and raw XML.

name: aria_diagnostics_vm_action
description: Queue a native VM start, graceful shutdown, reboot, pause or resume. Guest shutdown/reboot completion is asynchronous.

name: aria_diagnostics_smart
description: Queue a read-only SMART health report for one physical disk. Does not start self-tests or change disk settings.

name: aria_diagnostics_security_capabilities
description: Report whether the host has a supported Trivy vulnerability scanner installed.

name: aria_diagnostics_security_scan
description: Queue a bounded vulnerability scan using installed Trivy. May download vulnerability databases and image metadata; reports findings and completeness.

name: aria_diagnostics_cleanup_plan
description: Show Docker disk-use and reclaimable-space estimates. Does not delete images, containers or volumes.

name: aria_diagnostics_device_assignments
description: Map explicitly assigned GPU/USB/device paths to containers and saved VM configurations. Shared paths are reported as observations, not proven conflicts.

name: aria_diagnostics_vm_config
description: Read inactive VM XML with opaque credential markers and the exact original XML SHA256 for editing.

name: aria_diagnostics_vm_config_save
description: Queue an offline VM configuration edit. Requires matching original XML hash, same name and UUID, backs up the original, restores credential markers, and runs native libvirt schema validation before defining it.

name: aria_diagnostics_vm_snapshots
description: List native libvirt snapshots for one VM.

name: aria_diagnostics_vm_snapshot_read
description: Read one snapshot metadata summary and hash for guarded reversion.

name: aria_diagnostics_vm_snapshot_create
description: Queue an atomic internal snapshot of a shut-off VM with file-backed qcow2 writable disks. Requires current configuration hash. Unsupported libvirt/storage features are reported as failures.

name: aria_diagnostics_vm_snapshot_revert
description: Revert a shut-off qcow2 VM to an offline internal snapshot. Discards disk changes since that snapshot. Requires current configuration and snapshot hashes and explicit discard acknowledgement; saves current XML but does not back up current disk contents.

name: aria_diagnostics_monitor
description: Run bounded storage and container health monitoring. Records local inbox warnings at 90% filesystem use, critical alerts at 95%, and unhealthy or restarting container alerts. Deduplicates active incidents and never repairs automatically.

name: aria_diagnostics_history
description: Read bounded storage, monitor or explicitly sampled SMART history. Retains at most 288 samples and 4 MiB per category; no SMART scans are started by this read.

device.description: Optional device filter, valid only for smart history.
